title: visualization team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/visualization.yaml and its personal override docs/conventions/visualization.local.yaml. Resolution: plugins/visualization/skills/visualize/SKILL.md Step 3, the canvas server and diagram target rules.

hosted_canvas.description: allow lets /visualization:visualize send diagram content to a canvas server reached over the network (a remote MCP server) on a surface that renders one; deny keeps diagrams local or on a local server. deny from any layer (userConfig, this file, the personal override) wins.

diagram_target.description: Where /visualization:visualize draws a diagram: auto picks by surface; terminal an inline Mermaid or ASCII fence; local-page a local HTML file; excalidraw or tldraw that connected canvas server. A later layer wins (the personal override over this file over userConfig); a target that is unavailable, or that hosted_canvas forbids, falls back to auto.
